_comment: A hook in another harness gates a tool call on it without reading the code: deny is
refused with `reason`, ask goes to a person, allow changes nothing. A decision, rule or
key renamed, or an exit code moved, is therefore a contract change, and this file is the
third point that makes it deliberate: packages/gnomon-cli/src/guard.test.ts asserts the
code's GUARD_DECISIONS / GUARD_RULES / guardExit, the tables in CONTRACTS.md §10 and the
lists here are the same sets, and validates documents the real binary printed against
`verdict_keys`. The per-harness answers (`harness_answers`) are checked the same way.

exit_codes.10: no decision could be made; the document says decision ask, rule error, and why in `error`
